model_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';
SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > 150 AND price < 300;
SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM employees WHERE YEAR(hire_date) = 2023;
SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT inventory_id, product_id, warehouse_id, quantity FROM inventory WHERE quantity < 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories;
SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL;
SELECT first_name, last_name, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'Hamburg'
SELECT department_name, location FROM departments WHERE location = 'Berlin';
SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Laptops';
SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;
SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Sales';
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.status FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE e.first_name = 'Julia' AND e.last_name = 'Becker';
SELECT product_id, quantity FROM inventory WHERE warehouse_name = 'Munich Regional Warehouse';
SELECT product_name, quantity FROM products WHERE quantity > 2;
SELECT product_name, quantity FROM products WHERE quantity < 30;
SELECT o.order_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.order_date FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Munich';
SELECT li.order_id, li.product_id, li.quantity, li.unit_price FROM line_items li JOIN orders o ON li.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Audio'
SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Fulfillment'
SELECT o.order_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.status FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Germany' AND o.status = 'Completed';
SELECT product_id, quantity FROM inventory WHERE fulfillment_center = 'Hamburg Fulfillment Center' AND quantity > 100;
SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM order_details JOIN products ON order_details.product_id = products.product_id WHERE order_details.unit_price > 500;
SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Fitness Equipment';

SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name ORDER BY d.department_name;
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(od.quantity) AS total_sold FROM products p JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY YEAR(order_date) ORDER BY order_year;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS laptop_customers FROM orders WHERE product_type = 'laptop' OR product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE category = 'laptop');
SELECT p.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category_name;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY c.first_name, c.last_name;

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_handled FROM employees e LEFT JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY e.employee_id;
SELECT w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_stock FROM warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory i ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name ORDER BY w.warehouse_name;
SELECT c.category_name, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name;
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY c.category_name;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 3 ORDER BY order_count DESC;

SELECT category_name, SUM(price * quantity) as revenue FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id JOIN categories ON products.category_id = categories.category_id GROUP BY category_name HAVING SUM(price * quantity) > 5000 ORDER BY revenue DESC;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status;
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(s.quantity) as total_units FROM products p JOIN stock s ON p.product_id = s.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_units DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.category_name, AVG(o.unit_price) as avg_sold_price FROM order_items o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name;

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, SUM(s.quantity * p.price) AS smartphone_sales FROM employees e JOIN sales s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Smartphones' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY smartphone_sales DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(o.total_amount) as total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > (SELECT AVG(customer_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(o2.total_amount) as customer_total FROM orders o2 GROUP BY o2.customer_id) as avg_table) ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)
SELECT product_name, price, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) as price_rank FROM products;
SELECT p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.product_id IS NULL;

SELECT p.product_name, p.price, c.category_name FROM products p INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE (p.category_id, p.price) IN (SELECT category_id, MAX(price) FROM products GROUP BY category_id);

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(o.total_amount) as total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC) as spend_rank FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY spend_rank;
SELECT order_id, order_value FROM orders WHERE order_value > (SELECT AVG(order_value) FROM orders)

SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%laptop%'
AND w.warehouse_name = 'Berlin'

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, p.product_name, od.quantity, od.unit_price, (od.quantity * od.unit_price) AS line_total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.customer_id = (SELECT c2.customer_id FROM customers c2 JOIN orders o2 ON c2.customer_id = o2.customer_id JOIN order_details od2 ON o2.order_id = od2.order_id GROUP BY c2.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(od2.quantity * od2.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY line_total DESC;
